subject.title: ci(cloudflare): deploy crawl-remote from protected ClawSweeper environment

question: Do repository owners approve making the protected ClawSweeper environment and the explicitly named dispatcher the sole crawl-remote production deployment authority?
rationale: Technical review verifies that the proposed restriction is enforced, but it cannot authorize the long-term credential owner, sole operator, or coordinated two-repository cutover.

options.title: Approve the narrow authority
options.body: Merge the workflow fail-closed, coordinate the companion retirement, provision the protected environment, and supervise the first rollout.

options.title: Generalize operator authorization
options.body: Require a durable owner-approved operator-control mechanism instead of the individual actor gate before enabling production.

options.title: Retain service-owned deployment
options.body: Keep production mutation in crawl-remote under the existing authority model and do not complete this cutover.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow authority
recommendation.body: Merge the workflow fail-closed, coordinate the companion retirement, provision the protected environment, and supervise the first rollout.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the dominant historical owner of repository workflows and provide the strongest independent authority review separate from the implementation author.
